cases.target_need: What binding offtake commitments for carbon capture module were disclosed within the 180-day window ending at prediction time, and what still-effective binding offtake commitments were disclosed before that window?
cases.selection_reason: Check binding offtake commitments for carbon capture module with deliveries within the 180-day window ending at prediction time.
cases.residual_need: Using disclosures available by 2025-05-30, establish still-effective binding offtake commitments for carbon capture module disclosed before the 180-day window.
cases.independent_reason: Delivery within180days and publication before180days can both hold for one commitment. Same digits/clock and opposite surface bounds are not a disjoint pair unless both modify disclosed. No new activity-period or transcript policy.

scope: Synthetic local input strings on unchanged native parser and exact previously frozen definitions; no assertions that synthetic names are historical facts. No source/model/Signal/Store/LabelStore/stage entry.
expectation_boundary: Literal syntax can prove local complete object attachment or disjoint disclosure intervals under one clock. It does not prove issuer identity equivalence, economic entailment, arbitrary pronoun attachment, different-window nonoverlap, source existence, or actual evidence. Global word bags cannot certify scope attribution.
native_check: Real offline parser: positive requires direct first answer partial with unchanged row and siblings; negative cannot silently retain answer ownership. Existing typed correction/fallback allowed. Typed invalid control may reject outside overlap helper; record that cause separately.
